segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מִי שֶׁקִּידֵּשׁ אַחַת מִשְׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת, וְאֵין יוֹדֵעַ אֵי זֹה מֵהֶן קִידֵּשׁ — נוֹתֵן גֵּט לָזוֹ וְגֵט לָזוֹ. מֵת וְלוֹ אָח אֶחָד — חוֹלֵץ לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who betrothed one of two sisters and does not know which of them he betrothed,» so that both are forbidden to him, he «gives a bill of divorce to this one and a bill of divorce to that one» due to the uncertainty. If the man who had betrothed one of these women «died» before he could give a bill of divorce, «and he had one brother,» that brother «performs ḥalitza with both of them,» but he may not take either in levirate marriage. This is because he does not know which woman is his yevama and which is forbidden to him as the sister of a woman with whom he has a levirate bond.

segments.he: הָיוּ לוֹ שְׁנַיִם — אֶחָד חוֹלֵץ וְאֶחָד מְיַיבֵּם. קָדְמוּ וְכָנְסוּ — אֵין מוֹצִיאִין מִיָּדָם.
segments.en: If the man who betrothed one of these women «had two» brothers, «one» of them «performs ḥalitza» with one of the sisters, but he may not enter into levirate marriage with her due to the possibility that she is the sister of a woman with whom he has a levirate bond. «And one takes» the other «in levirate marriage» if he so desires. If the two brothers «married» the two sisters «before» consulting the court, the court does not «remove them» from their marriage and they are permitted to remain married. The couple who performed levirate marriage second was even permitted to do so, since there was no longer any doubt about the levirate bond.

segments.he: שְׁנַיִם שֶׁקִּדְּשׁוּ שְׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת, זֶה אֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ אֵי זוֹ קִידֵּשׁ, וְזֶה אֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ אֵיזוֹ קִידֵּשׁ — זֶה נוֹתֵן שְׁנֵי גִיטִּין, וְזֶה נוֹתֵן שְׁנֵי גִיטִּין. מֵתוּ, לָזֶה אָח וְלָזֶה אָח — זֶה חוֹלֵץ לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן, וְזֶה חוֹלֵץ לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן.
segments.en: Furthermore, in the case of «two» unrelated men «who betrothed two sisters:» If «this one does not know which» sister «he betrothed and that one does not know which» sister «he betrothed, this one gives two bills of divorce,» one to each of the women, «and that one gives two bills of divorce.» If the two men «died» before they divorced, and «this one had a brother and that one had a brother,» then «this» brother «performs ḥalitza with both of them, and that» brother «performs ḥalitza with both of them.»

segments.he: לָזֶה אֶחָד וְלָזֶה שְׁנַיִם — הַיָּחִיד חוֹלֵץ לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן, וְהַשְּׁנַיִם — אֶחָד חוֹלֵץ, וְאֶחָד מְיַיבֵּם. קָדְמוּ וְכָנְסוּ, אֵין מוֹצִיאִין מִיָּדָם. לָזֶה שְׁנַיִם וְלָזֶה שְׁנַיִם — אָחִיו שֶׁל זֶה חוֹלֵץ לְאַחַת, וְאָחִיו שֶׁל זֶה חוֹלֵץ לְאַחַת. אָחִיו שֶׁל זֶה מְיַיבֵּם חֲלוּצָתוֹ שֶׁל זֶה, וְאָחִיו שֶׁל זֶה מְיַיבֵּם חֲלוּצָתוֹ שֶׁל זֶה.
segments.en: If «this one had one» brother «and that one had two» brothers, «the single» brother «performs ḥalitza with both of them, and» of «the two» brothers, «one performs ḥalitza and one performs levirate marriage» if he so desires. If «they married» the sisters «before» consulting the court, the court «does not remove them» from the marriage and they are not told to divorce them. If «this one had two» brothers «and that one had two» brothers, «the brother of this one performs ḥalitza with one» sister, «and the brother of that one performs ḥalitza with one» sister. «The brother of this» one who performed ḥalitza «may take the woman who performed ḥalitza [ḥalutza] of that» other’s brother «in levirate marriage, and the brother of that» second one who performed ḥalitza «may take the ḥalutza of that» other’s brother «in levirate marriage.»

segments.he: קָדְמוּ שְׁנַיִם וְחָלְצוּ — לֹא יְיַבְּמוּ הַשְּׁנַיִם, אֶלָּא אֶחָד חוֹלֵץ וְאֶחָד מְיַיבֵּם. קָדְמוּ וְכָנְסוּ — אֵין מוֹצִיאִין מִיָּדָם.
segments.en: If the two brothers «performed ḥalitza» with both wives «before» consulting the court, «the» two brothers of the second man «may not take»either sister «in levirate marriage» lest one marry the sister of a woman with whom he had a levirate bond. «Rather, one performs ḥalitza and one performs levirate marriage» if he so desires. If «they married» their wives «before» consulting the court, the court «does not remove them» from the marriage.

moves.summary: Betrothed one of two sisters, unknown which: divorce both; one brother performs halitza with both
Two brothers: one halitza, one levirate marriage; if they married first, not removed
Two men each betrothed an unknown sister: each gives two bills; each brother performs halitza with both
If two performed halitza first, the other two may not both perform levirate marriage

positions.claim: where the betrothed sister is unknown, divorce both; brothers perform halitza before any levirate marriage; if they married first, they are not removed
